description: This file defines the 'Job' class, which models a job entity with properties like tenantId, type, key, entityId, status, configuration, and result. It includes methods for presetting results, retrieving configuration, and extracting error messages based on job status and task results.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a job with properties such as tenantId, type, key, entityId, status, configuration, and result. Supports presetting results and extracting error messages.

methods.name: presetResult
methods.description: Initializes the result property based on the job type, e.g., for DUMMY type, assigns a DummyJobResult.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the job's configuration cast to a specific subclass.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Generates an error message based on job status and task results, including handling cancellations and general errors.
